description.en: Runs ffmpeg on each file: compresses videos, turns HEIC photos into JPEG, makes thumbnails. Needs the plugin exec, installed with it.
description.fr: Lance ffmpeg sur chaque fichier : compresse les vidéos, convertit les photos HEIC en JPEG, fait des miniatures. Nécessite le plugin exec, installé avec lui.
description.it: Esegue ffmpeg su ogni file: comprime i video, converte le foto HEIC in JPEG, crea miniature. Richiede il plugin exec, installato insieme.

changes.en: First version: the ffmpeg actions of the plugin exec 1.0.0 in a plugin of their own.
changes.fr: Première version : les actions ffmpeg du plugin exec 1.0.0 dans un plugin à part.
changes.it: Prima versione: le azioni ffmpeg del plugin exec 1.0.0 in un plugin a sé.

notice.en: Copybot does not ship ffmpeg. When asked, the plugin downloads a build of FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) by BtbN (https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds), licensed under the GNU General Public License (GPL) v3: the user downloads it and uses it under that license, whose text comes with that build; the sources of FFmpeg are on https://ffmpeg.org.
notice.fr: Copybot ne livre pas ffmpeg. À la demande, le plugin télécharge une compilation de FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) faite par BtbN (https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds), sous licence GNU General Public License (GPL) v3 : l'utilisateur la télécharge et l'utilise selon cette licence, dont le texte accompagne cette compilation ; les sources de FFmpeg sont sur https://ffmpeg.org.
notice.it: Copybot non distribuisce ffmpeg. Su richiesta, il plugin scarica una build di FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) realizzata da BtbN (https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds), con licenza GNU General Public License (GPL) v3: l'utente la scarica e la usa secondo tale licenza, il cui testo accompagna la build; i sorgenti di FFmpeg sono su https://ffmpeg.org.
